subject: Next steps: compact demo cadence & timeblocks for CloverTech
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reyes <alex.reyes@clovertech.io>, Priya Shah <priya@clovertech.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: compact demo cadence & timeblocks for CloverTech

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Goal: 30-min product intro to show relevant workflow (inference latency/cost controls, routing & fallbacks) and surface the things Raj/Security will likely ask about (data residency, audit logs).
- Fit signals: you mentioned a proof-of-concept interest for an inference gateway to offload burst traffic and standardize model routing. Good match for Redwood Dedicated + private routing.

Proposed 30-minute demo slots (PT). Please pick one, or tell me if you'd prefer any of these shifted by an hour: 
1) Thu 29 Oct — 10:00–10:30 PT
2) Fri 30 Oct — 14:00–14:30 PT
3) Mon 2 Nov — 11:00–11:30 PT

Ask: who should join from your side? For a compact intro we typically suggest: product/ML owner, infra lead, and security/compliance contact (if available). If you prefer a technical deep-dive instead, Jonas (solutions engineer) can lead a 60-min technical session.

Attached: short 2-page agenda + the discovery notes I captured. Also linking a provisional calendar invite (we'll finalize after you confirm): https://calendar.redwood.ai/invite/CLV-482-30m

Next steps: confirm slot + final attendee list and I’ll send a calendar invite with dial-in + prep notes.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0189
https://redwood.ai

--
Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (2 pages), clv-discovery-notes.txt
From: Alex Reyes <alex.reyes@clovertech.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@clovertech.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 21:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: compact demo cadence & timeblocks for CloverTech

Thanks Tessa — useful recap.

We’re keen to see the demo. Quick notes:
- Prefer Fri 30 Oct but can we move it 1 hour earlier to 13:00–13:30 PT? We have a standing weekly at 14:00.
- Attendees from our side: Priya (Head of Data), Raj Patel (Infra Lead) <raj.patel@clovertech.io>, and Sam Torres (Security) <sam.torres@clovertech.io>.

If moving the time is hard, the Mon 2 Nov slot works as well. Either way, 30 mins works for the intro — if we need to carve a separate technical deep-dive after this, we’ll flag it.

Appreciate the agenda — I’ll loop in Raj and Sam on confirm.

—Alex
Alex Reyes
Dir. of Product Operations, CloverTech
alex.reyes@clovertech.io
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reyes <alex.reyes@clovertech.io>, Priya Shah <priya@clovertech.io>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@clovertech.io>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@clovertech.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: compact demo cadence & timeblocks for CloverTech

Perfect — thanks for the quick reply and attendee list, Alex. I’ve locked Fri, 30 Oct, 13:00–13:30 PT for the 30-min product intro and sent a calendar invite to everyone (link below).

What to expect in the session:
- 5m: intro + success criteria
- 15m: live demo focused on routing, cost controls (batching/quantization recommendations), and fallback strategies
- 7m: Q&A (security & infra items)
- 3m: next steps (technical deep-dive / POC scope)

Jonas will lead the demo and take any technical questions; I’ll cover commercial fit and next steps. Grace will help coordinate post-demo materials and the POC checklist.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.ai/invite/CLV-482-30m
Discovery notes & agenda attached. Let me know if you need us to accommodate a different timezone for other teammates.

See you all on 30th — I’ll include a brief pre-read in the invite.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0189

--
